_readme: Loops side settings (owner rulings 2026-10-24, Handoffs/Loops Settings Build.md). Read by tools/loop_vocab.py.
Kept OUT of crew_config.json on purpose: evolution rewrites that file daily.
_groups: word -> group for loop picks. A word here wins over the same word in flavor_tags (inside loop titles 'boom' = hip hop, not 808; 'dark' = dark/horror).
_texture: texture words that join an existing flavor_tags family (owner ruling 3). 'dry' has no family, so it matches only itself.
_lead_types: lead loops split by title words (owner ruling 4). No match = 'other', steered by folder style words.
_finish: mood group -> EQ dB (added to the identity's own mix EQ) and glue word. Loops only. Draft v1, untuned, judged by ear only when he asks for a render.

ONE row per identity (owner 2026-10-24, replaces 'add up, capped': adding pinned 44 of 45 at the cap): the group with the most distinct matching words wins; a tie goes to the group named first in the listen line.
_glue: glue word -> glue_compress ratio. Claude's draft numbers (house ratio is 1.8), not sourced, not heard.
_title_only: words that count only inside loop titles, never in a listen line (owner 2026-10-24: '57% swing' is groove feel, not jazz).
partynextdoor dropped by owner 2026-10-24; wrld kept.
Identity entries (added by each Loops-side rebuild): "<name>": {"words": [extra steering words]}. The listen line is read from the identity's own config, never copied here.
